limits.en: Free for teams; read-only collaborators, form submissions and share links do not count toward seats.

keyLimits.en: Billed per seat with edit permissions, annual billing; read-only collaborators and form submissions are free.
Adds customization, larger data scale and administrative features; prorated billing for mid-cycle additions.
Unlimited org units, workspaces and bases; requires sales consultation for pricing.

cautions.en: Monthly (non-annual) price for Team and Business not shown on the pricing page in this session; only the annual-billed per-seat rate was visible ($20 and $45 respectively).

capabilities.en: Flexible relational-database-style workspace combining spreadsheet UI with linked records, views and automations.
Free plan available to teams with core building blocks, positioned to replace lighter CRM, project and content tools.
Data retention policy: Airtable states it will never remove data when plan limits (records, attachments) are reached, only prompt an upgrade.

limitations.en: Records, attachments, automations and API usage are capped by plan; exceeding them requires an upgrade rather than pay-as-you-go overage.
Only seats with edit permissions are billed, so per-seat costs can be hard to predict for teams with mixed access levels.

reason.en: Spreadsheet/database hybrid work management tool targeting similar flexible-database use cases.
All-in-one workspace often compared to Airtable for lightweight database and project tracking needs.
Work OS platform competing for team project/database management budgets.

unknowns: Exact numeric limits for records, attachments, and automations per plan not extracted in this session (page referenced them without listing figures).
